2608.12888.title: When Your Agent Opens the Chat App: Agent-Controlled Search over Raw Chat Logs Rivals Structured Memory
2608.12888.paper_summary: Agent-memory systems increasingly buy retrieval quality with structure, transforming raw conversation histories into summaries, embeddings, trees, or knowledge graphs before any question is asked. We ask how much of that benefit comes from the structure itself, rather than from competent retrieval over the raw history. We present ReFind, an agent-controlled search interface that builds no semantic structure at all: it leaves the conversation archive unmodified, indexes it lexically at turn granularity, and combines a generic iterative keyword-search loop with four chat-native controls grounded in empirical refinding work: session-aware rank fusion, local context expansion, temporal narrowing, and skipping already-inspected sessions. A separate reasoning stage answers from the collected evidence. Across a broad suite of conversational-memory tasks (single- and multi-hop QA, event ordering, and fact consolidation), roughly 2,800 questions on precise-retrieval and fact-tracking capabilities evaluated under the incremental multi-turn setting of MemoryAgentBench, ReFind attains the highest mean accuracy (58.2) of any system compared, above the strongest graph- and tree-based memory systems (HippoRAG 2, 53.2), all under a GPT-4o-mini backbone matched to every reused baseline. Controlled comparisons to single-shot BM25, a matched generic-agentic BM25 control, component removals, and agentic dense/hybrid variants separately support the roles of agent control, chat-native controls, and lexical retrieval. On LongMemEval-S/M, the same interface reaches 93.2 +/- 3.3 and 89.3 +/- 6.0 with GPT-5-mini. The results indicate that for precise, evidence-grounded questions over chat archives, much of the benefit credited to elaborate memory structures is recoverable by giving an agent controllable search over the unmodified record, with no LLM-based index construction at all.
2608.12888.paper_summary_zh: 代理記憶系統越來越多地通過結構來提高檢索質量，將原始對話歷史轉換為摘要、嵌入、樹或知識圖譜，而在任何問題被提出之前。我們詢問這種好處有多少來自於結構本身，而不是來自於對原始歷史的有效檢索。我們提出了 ReFind，一個不建立任何語義結構的代理控制搜索介面：它保持對話檔案不變，按回合粒度進行詞彙索引，並將通用的迭代關鍵字搜索循環與四個基於實證重新發現工作的聊天原生控制結合起來：會話感知排名融合、本地上下文擴展、時間範圍縮小和跳過已檢查的會話。一個單獨的推理階段根據收集的證據進行回答。在一系列廣泛的對話記憶任務中（單跳和多跳問答、事件排序和事實整合），大約 2,800 個問題在 MemoryAgentBench 的增量多回合設置下評估了精確檢索和事實跟蹤能力，ReFind 在所有比較的系統中達到了最高的平均準確率（58.2），超過了最強的基於圖和樹的記憶系統（HippoRAG 2，53.2），所有這些都在與每個重用基準相匹配的 GPT-4o-mini 背景下進行。對單次 BM25 的受控比較、一個匹配的通用代理 BM25 控制、組件移除，以及代理密集/混合變體分別支持了代理控制、聊天原生控制和詞彙檢索的角色。在 LongMemEval-S/M 上，相同的介面在 GPT-5-mini 下達到了 93.2 +/- 3.3 和 89.3 +/- 6.0。結果表明，對於基於證據的精確問題，許多歸因於複雜記憶結構的好處可以通過給予代理可控的搜索權限來恢復，無需進行任何基於 LLM 的索引構建。
